reviews.text: Great place, excellent doctors but VERY expensive.

Dr. Tapia is absolutely amazing. Her compassion and care are undeniable and her team is incredible. Whether your fur baby is young or near the end of their life, they will do EVERYTHING to take care of them. Thank you, Amigo.

Dr. Tapia and staff are the most dedicated and caring team I have encountered in my 12 years in San Antonio. Lil' Chonk has entered her senior years (please do not tell her this! She is still in denial!). Her teeth have been becoming worse and worse. Chonk is nearing 13 years old- Dr. Tapia's routine tooth inspection revealed that my little grand-kitty was in a lot of pain. Her teefies were rotting at the gum line! I agreed to have the teeth discovered in the x-ray removed and set up the appointment. The staff called me several weeks later and got Chonk in earlier due to a cancellation. She did not act like she was in pain. But, I took the earlier appointment. Dr. Tapia and staff called me during the surgery, let me know how bad her teeth were, and gave me the option to just pull the teeth they originally deemed "bad", or to have all of the actual bad teeth pulled. I am now the proud grandparent of a senior cat with 5 teeth left! The staff worked well after hours to complete Chonk's surgery, and now that she is home without her safety cone I wanted to give a review.
My grand kitty has never been super-affectionate. We rescued from a kill shelter, and she has always been an independent little thing. Since her teeth were removed, she now "demands" to be held every night, she inserts herself into conversations, and purrs loudly for seemingly no reason. Her entire demeanor is different since the teeth removal. We can only assume the amount of pain she was in with those teeth (that no other vet ever brought to our attention) were causing her to be stand-offish. Chonk is one happy kitty keeping grandma busy making her blankies to make biscuits all over the house. I cannot recommend Dr. Tapia and staff highly enough for all they have done!

I have had nothing but great experiences bringing my two cats here for the past 2 years. Every member of the staff is kind, compassionate, and incredibly patient with our cats.

One of my cats had always breathed a little differently, and we assumed it was normal, especially since his previous veterinarian had never expressed any concern. During his exam, Dr. Mata immediately recognized that his breathing was not normal. She recommended X-rays, which led to a diagnosis of a diaphragmatic hernia. We had no idea how serious his condition was until she took the time to explain everything to us.

Not long afterward, he developed alarming symptoms and had to undergo emergency surgery. I am so grateful that Dr. Mata had identified the problem early, referred us to BluePearl, and already had his records and X-rays sent over. That made a stressful emergency much smoother and helped us get him the care he needed as quickly as possible.

Dr. Mata is thorough, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about her patients. She takes the time to explain her findings, answer questions, and offer thoughtful advice for keeping our pets healthy and happy. We are incredibly thankful for the care she has provided our cats, and I highly recommend her and the entire team.

What a great team of people. They not only take care of my pet they also go out of their way to help my pet's family, ME. Everyone from the front desk to the technicians and Dr. Mata have always done great things for my dog INKIE. Thank you DR. Mata for going a little bit further to help my pet. Since she can't thank you I will, thank you Dr. Mata and thank you to your team of pet lovers.
our Abraham was on his death bed now he is back at work

Thank you for taking care of our pup for 11 yrs. Your staff is great. Very loving and compassionate. Thank you for coming to our house to put our beloved Winter to rest. We will forever be grateful for giving her that peace of being at home. Dr. Mata and staff thank you for everything! !
Love , Love, Love the vet clinic and Dr. Tapia is awsome along with the staff very friendly and welcoming.

My husband and I were looking to get our Yorkie-Poo's nails clipped.  Her dew claws also needed to be clipped as they had curled and were at the brink of digging into her paw pads. We decided to call Amigo Animal Hospital based on the reviews on-line.  We are throughly pleased with the customer service and the treatment of our furbaby.  We will definitely be going back for nail clipping.  Our furbaby is due for a wellness check in February, and we know where we'll be going.  See you soon.
Been with them for YEARS! They and their staff are caring and professional. I highly recommend them!

My dog has a unique situation and without getting into details, Dr. Lowe has been great as we are trying to diagnose. We truly appreciate the efforts and care she has provided trying to figure out what is going on while also taking the time to communicate with us answering our questions. These guys do care and it shows. The front staff and techs are all quality people. If you are looking for a quality vet I definitely recommend you look no further than Amigo.

I moved to San Antonio about 2 years ago. I needed to find a vet for my cat, Lana, who had previous health issues ranging from UTIs/struvite crystals, hyperthyroidism that was treated with radioactive iodine therapy and turned into hypothyroidism and early stages of chronic kidney disease. Dr. Lowe was assigned as Lana's vet and I couldn't have been luckier. Dr. Lowe went above an beyond. She spoke to my previous vet from out of state, she researched radioactive iodine therapy so that she could give Lana the most comprehensive care moving forward, she would call me after hours with lab results and most importantly...she cared so much about Lana's well being. The front desk staff is so friendly and compassionate. The vet techs are all so knowledgeable and warm. When my Lana was diagnosed with cancer, I visited Amigo Animal Hospital every week & sometimes multiple times a week. I called them multiple times a week. I made last minute appointments and picked up last minute medications/food. Every step of the way, Amigo Animal Hospital never made me feel like a bother, shared in the sadness I had and helped me provide Lana with the best hospice care possible. When my little baby passed at home with me, surrounded by her loved ones, Dr. Lowe was the first person I called and she answered and shared her condolences with me. Without a doubt, Dr. Lowe & Amigo Animal Hospital allowed Lana to have a few more good weeks before her time came. We got to share so many more memories during that time that I will forever be grateful for. My little Lana was a fighter and Dr. Lowe & Amigo Animal Hospital helped Lana fight as long as she could.
All staff members are so knowledgeable, kind, compassionate. They prioritize the animals wellbeing.  I highly recommend them.
Friendly staff and easy scheduling.
Very caring and thorough veterinarians. Our pets are in good hands here!
Staff is friendly and they take great care of my chihuahua Darci😊 …

I absolutely love Amigo Animal Hospital and Dr. Tapia is truly an angel.  They are the only veterinary hospital I trust.  I’ve been taking all my babies here for years and the amount of love and outstanding medical care is above all others.
Very nice people, they took care of my Boston Terrier. Very expensive compared to some places but extremely convenient so it's worth the extra cost.

I have adopted dogs since I was in my twenties. I am now 69. Dr. Tapia is the most caring, knowledgeable veterinarian that I have ever been blessed to know. It is comforting to know that there are still people in the world that care enough to go the extra mile for your four legged family! Thank you Dr. Tapia for showing my four legged family so much love and concern! You are the best!!!!
I highly recommend this clinic and Dr. Tapia to anyone who cares about their pets!!!!
The vets and staff are so helpful. Dr. Tapia has been seeing our dogs for almost 9 years and she treats them like they are her own pets.
Amazing Service
Love this place. They helped us keep our beloved Alice with us still... Thank you to all the staff...
Always caring and attentive servuce
Dr. Lowe and her staff were great with my pit. Called over a concern and got scheduled same day. They made my dog very comfortable and stayed patient with him throughout the visit.
Dr. Lowe was so thorough with my cat’s exam and the techs were all fantastic. I’m happy to have found a great vet hospital!
Dr. Tapia has been very good for my family. She is professional, patient, and compassionate. We'll continue bringing our furry family here because we know they're in good hands. Thank you!

I cannot express how thankful we are for all the staff at Amigo Animal Hospital. After moving here last summer, we found this veterinarian and Dr. Lowe immediately took our little Cocoa under her care. We had 17 years of veterinary care for our sweet boy and NEVER had I seen him be treated so gentle and with love. They truly do treat your babies as if they were their own. Unfortunately our sweet senior boy had to be put down, but we are comforted in knowing he had THE BEST care in his last year of life 🥹
Dr. Lowe, thank you so much for your care and comfort during our goodbye. You made the process so gentle and were so understanding. You’ll always hold a special place in our hearts for that. When the time comes for our family to add a new best friend, we only hope you and your staff will be the ones walking along beside us on our new journey 🥹💗

Incredible veterinary care!  Dr Liz Lowe is unique in that she never assumes she knows everything and is open to discussion and research when your pet needs beyond-routine care.  (I did my research...she graduated top of her class at Tufts and has critical care experience).  Her beside manner is extraordinary. I have no doubt that she has my pets best interests at heart...AND she is able to relate to me and my concerns and even my emotional needs when my pets are sick.
The staff has been professional and caring. They are welcoming and have a wonderful attention to detail. There is no way around it. Veterinary care is not cheap anywhere but I have compared and the quality of care and the prices make Amigo affordable. And yes…I drive all the way to Potranco/1604 from Boerne because Dr Lowe is worth it!

I was looking for a new vet for my 7 furbabies.  I always test a place by bringing 1 and see how they take care of them and me. Amigo Hospital is one of the BEST! I brought in little Rosey and they treated her like the most precious gift …
Dr. and assistants really care about our pets

Dr. Lowe and Dr. Tapia and their staff are truly top notch. They always go above and beyond when caring for their patients and their owners.
We’ve been going to Amigo since we got our puppy at 2.5 months old. He is now …
